pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large irregular polygonal regions with highly serrated and jagged pixel-level edge gradients. Patch spatial area is highest on the neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented clusters toward the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-toned pathways. High density of junction nodes (primarily 3-way intersections). Pixel thickness is generally consistent across the mid-flank but narrows into finer filaments between smaller distal patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper cervical ridge, becoming less distinct and lower in frequency toward the shoulder hump.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Short structural discontinuity in mane density observed at the transitional junction between the mid-neck and the shoulder ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple thin, linear, hypopigmented marks (scars) are visible on the lower-mid flank and the ventral-flank transition area, including one prominent diagonal mark and several smaller horizontal streaks.
